exposure: mean uterine artery (UtA) Doppler PI MoM >= 95th percentile
outcome: obstetric intervention (OI) for suspected intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC)
cohort: The participants were 804 low-risk singleton term pregnancies with spontaneous onset of labor, recruited from four tertiary Maternity Units.
finding: A predictive model combining antenatal and intrapartum characteristics with abnormal CPR and mean UtA PI demonstrated good capacity to rule out and moderate capacity to rule in obstetric intervention for suspected intrapartum fetal compromise, despite having a poor positive predictive value.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken in early labor.
